additional_info.subject: RE: ID0374173-DC/Si-D/IE-[MP / S2 170003301] Charging interruption CRM:00643000865
additional_info.body:
Hi Jason,
I hope all is well.
We have analyzed the logs for the date mentioned in the webform, as well as the timestamp you provided on MS Teams (14th August, 10-11 am).
For the interrupted charging sessions on 11th August, the issue was due to authentication not being completed. In one of the attempts, the charging session failed because of an invalid ID tag. I noticed multiple charging sessions on different outlets on 11th August where authentication was successful, and those sessions proceeded without issue.
On 14th August, I reviewed the logs, and the issue appears to be related to the EV, not the EVSE. The attempt was made on DC Outlet 2, and although authentication was successful, the EV dropped the voltage during the cable check process, leading to a communication problem from the EV side. I'm attaching the logs and a document for the exact timestamp why the charging session was interrupted.
Regarding the missing logs due to signal strength, I reviewed the OCPP connectivity and found no issues. There were no instances where the OCPP went offline, as you can see in the attached snapshot for your reference. Also the charger logs during this time we don't have any time difference in UTC & AWS cloud watch time.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey
